svg.text: ⚠️ ILLEGAL UNDER CAL. CIV. CODE § 1950.5 (Non-refundable deposit & over 1-month rent cap)
⚠️ UNENFORCEABLE: Pre-Dispute Jury Waiver (Grafton Partners v. Superior Court)

g.text: STANDARD FORM MULTI-FAMILY HOUSING (SANTA MONICA JURISDICTION)
OWNER / AGENT: Pacific Horizon Properties LLC
PREMISES: 1420 Ocean Avenue, Apt 12, Santa Monica, CA 90401
MONTHLY RENT: $2,800.00 / month, payable on the 1st day of each month
SECTION 4. SECURITY DEPOSIT AND NON-REFUNDABLE CHARGES:
Resident shall deposit the sum of $5,600.00 (two months rent) as security deposit.
In addition, Resident shall pay an upfront non-refundable cleaning surcharge of $800.00.
SECTION 11. WAIVER OF RIGHT TO JURY TRIAL & MANDATORY ARBITRATION:
Resident knowingly, voluntarily, and irrevocably waives all constitutional and statutory
rights to a trial by jury in any action or proceeding arising out of this Tenancy.
SECTION 16. ACCESS AND INSPECTION BY OWNER:
Owner reserves the unrestricted right to enter the dwelling unit at any time without
written 24-hour advance notice for general inspections or showings.
